candidates.title: MolmoSpaces: A Large-Scale Open Ecosystem for Robot Navigation and Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: Large open cross-simulator scene, asset, grasp, task, and benchmark ecosystem with recent releases.

candidates.title: VLA-JEPA: Enhancing Vision-Language-Action Model with Latent World Model
candidates.why_candidate: Latent future-state world supervision for VLA with public LeRobot integration.

candidates.title: Point-It-Out: Benchmarking Embodied Reasoning for Vision Language Models in Multi-Stage Visual Grounding
candidates.why_candidate: TMLR benchmark grounds embodied reasoning in boxes, points, and action traces.

candidates.title: Geometry-aware 4D Video Generation for Robot Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: ICLR multi-view RGB-D world generation with downstream 6-DoF action extraction.

candidates.title: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: Geometry-distilled video world model with adaptive inverse dynamics and real robot evidence.

candidates.title: ORV: 4D Occupancy-centric Robot Video Generation
candidates.why_candidate: Occupancy/action-conditioned multi-view robot video generation with public code and extensive demos.

candidates.title: LeRobot v0.6.0: Imagine, Evaluate, Improve
candidates.why_candidate: Official infrastructure release integrating world-model policies, reward models, and unified benchmarks.

triage.reason: Fast-track open infrastructure with strong scale, code, benchmark, and relevance.
Newly influential via LeRobot release and direct latent-world/action integration.
Peer-reviewed diagnostic spatial-to-action benchmark with public data.
ICLR paper with strong geometry-aware demos, code, data, and execution evidence.
Direct world-to-action method with adequate official visual and physical evidence.
Public code, broad demos, dense state control, and downstream gains clear thresholds.
Important official infrastructure signal, but not a standalone research paper; underlying accepted papers are handled separately.
